_doc: 1.0.96 speech-only corrections for the Gemara cycles, carried over from the reviewed Aramaic prototype (/workspace/aramaic-eval/multi/pipeline/corrections.json, fixed3). words: Dicta/Davidson form -> [[speech word, stress index from the end], ...]. keepShva: forms whose initial shva stays vocal (shva-drop made the prototype's ASR hear חרחם / בתפילה). The prototype's בָּעֵי / אָתֵי splits were specific to its voice (BlueTTS) and are not used with Piper.
